passages.transcript:
N: Number 13.
W: Where is the quarterly report?
N: (A) On the shared drive.
N: (B) At the end of March.
N: (C) Yes, it was very long.

N: Number 14.
M: Who is leading tomorrow's training session?
N: (A) At nine o'clock.
N: (B) In the main conference room.
N: (C) Ms. Alvarez from HR.

N: Number 15.
W: How long will the renovation take?
N: (A) Around the corner.
N: (B) About three weeks.
N: (C) It costs a lot.

N: Number 16.
M: Why was the shipment delayed?
N: (A) To the Chicago office.
N: (B) Because of the snowstorm.
N: (C) By express mail.

N: Number 17.
W: Did you receive the contract I emailed yesterday?
N: (A) The meeting room is on the second floor.
N: (B) Yes, I'll review it this afternoon.
N: (C) She signed it last week.

N: Number 18.
M: Haven't you booked the flights yet?
N: (A) Not yet, I'm waiting for approval.
N: (B) Yes, the airport is close.
N: (C) Two seats by the window.

N: Number 19.
W: Could you send me the updated schedule?
N: (A) It starts at eight.
N: (B) Sure, I'll email it in a few minutes.
N: (C) The updated version is better.

N: Number 20.
M: Why don't we move the meeting to Thursday?
N: (A) The meeting was productive.
N: (B) Because it was cancelled.
N: (C) That works for me.

N: Number 21.
W: Is the printer on this floor working?
N: (A) Yes, I printed it in color.
N: (B) The technician is fixing it right now.
N: (C) It's on the third floor.

N: Number 22.
M: Do you want to take the train or fly to Boston?
N: (A) I took the train yesterday.
N: (B) Whichever is cheaper.
N: (C) Boston is a big city.

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.

fr.rule: Une question en « Where » attend un lieu (ici un emplacement de fichier).
why_wrong: B : donne une date (« When »).
C : répond par oui, impossible à une question en « Where ».

en.rule: A 'Where' question expects a place (here, a file location).
why_wrong: B: gives a time ('When').
C: answers with yes, impossible for a 'Where' question.

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.

why_wrong: A : donne une heure (« When »).
B : donne un lieu (« Where »).
A: gives a time ('When').
B: gives a place ('Where').

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.

fr.rule: « How long » interroge sur une durée.
why_wrong: A : « Around the corner » donne un lieu.
C : répond au coût (« How much »).
A: 'Around the corner' gives a location.
C: answers about cost ('How much').

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.

fr.rule: « Why » attend une cause. « Because of » + nom introduit la raison.
why_wrong: A : donne une destination (« Where »).
C : décrit un moyen d'envoi (« How »).

en.rule: 'Why' expects a reason. 'Because of' + noun introduces it.
why_wrong: A: gives a destination ('Where').
C: describes a method ('How').

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.
choices: The meeting room is on the second floor.
Yes, I'll review it this afternoon.

fr.rule: Une question fermée appelle souvent « Yes/No » suivi d'une précision cohérente.
why_wrong: A : parle d'un lieu sans rapport.
C : répond comme si on parlait d'une autre personne et d'un autre moment.
fr.example: Yes, I'll review it this afternoon.

en.rule: A yes/no question often gets 'Yes/No' plus a consistent detail.
why_wrong: A: talks about an unrelated place.
C: answers about another person and time.
en.example: Yes, I'll review it this afternoon.

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.
choices: Not yet, I'm waiting for approval.

fr.rule: Dans une question négative, « Not yet » confirme que l'action n'est pas faite. Ne vous laissez pas piéger par le mot « flights ».
why_wrong: B : « Yes » contredit l'idée, et l'aéroport est hors sujet.
C : répond à une préférence de siège, pas à la question.
fr.example: Not yet, I'm waiting for approval.

en.rule: In a negative question, 'Not yet' confirms the action is not done. Do not be fooled by the echo of 'flights'.
why_wrong: B: 'Yes' does not fit and the airport is off-topic.
C: answers a seat preference, not the question.
en.example: Not yet, I'm waiting for approval.

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.
choices: Sure, I'll email it in a few minutes.

fr.rule: Une demande polie (« Could you… ») appelle une acceptation ou un refus.
why_wrong: A : donne une heure sans accepter la demande.
C : commente la version sans répondre à la demande.
fr.example: Sure, I'll email it in a few minutes.

en.rule: A polite request ('Could you…') gets an acceptance or refusal.
why_wrong: A: gives a time without accepting the request.
C: comments on the version but does not answer the request.
en.example: Sure, I'll email it in a few minutes.

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.

fr.rule: « Why don't we… » est une suggestion, pas une vraie question de cause. On y répond par accord ou désaccord.
why_wrong: A : parle du passé, ne répond pas à la suggestion.
B : traite la phrase comme une question de cause.

en.rule: 'Why don't we…' is a suggestion, not a real 'why' question. Answer with agreement or disagreement.
why_wrong: A: talks about the past, does not answer the suggestion.
B: treats it as a cause question.

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.
choices: Yes, I printed it in color.
The technician is fixing it right now.

fr.rule: Réponse indirecte : « the technician is fixing it » sous-entend que non, pas encore.
why_wrong: A : « printed » est un écho de « printer » sans répondre.
C : répète « floor » mais ne répond pas à l'état de l'imprimante.
fr.example: The technician is fixing it right now.

en.rule: Indirect answer: 'the technician is fixing it' implies it is not working yet.
why_wrong: A: 'printed' echoes 'printer' without answering.
C: repeats 'floor' but ignores the printer status.
en.example: The technician is fixing it right now.

questions.stem: Listen to the question and the three responses. Choose the best response.

fr.rule: Une question alternative (A ou B) peut recevoir « Whichever… » : ni l'un ni l'autre n'est exclu.
why_wrong: A : parle d'hier, pas du choix à venir.
C : commente la ville sans répondre.

en.rule: An alternative question (A or B) can be answered 'Whichever…'.
why_wrong: A: talks about yesterday, not the upcoming choice.
C: comments on the city without answering.
